author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Integrate opt-in Pi vision reception with original capture expiry
details: Share uploader boot, BOOTTIME and bounded original-frame ledger with the accepted freshness gate. Establish header-authenticated verified WSS before capture, reject mismatched/stale/replayed results, expire independently of blocked reads and invalidate on interruption. No phone enrollment, remote drift claim, motor outputs or full-policy completion.
validation: 26 edge tests passed on Windows and Linux Python 3.12, including real local HTTPS/WSS using synthetic backend observations, idle expiry and fresh-result revocation. Windows backend regression: 128 discovered, 121 passed, seven skips. Shared/repository/changelog/whitespace checks run by checked publisher. Real Pi receiver test remains pending.
